items.name: 抹茶水果千層
items.description: 日式抹茶的微苦甘醇與新鮮水果的酸甜完美融合，多層次的風味帶來豐富的口感體驗，抹茶的香氣與水果的清新交織，為味蕾帶來意想不到的驚喜。
items.description_en: The subtle bitterness of Japanese matcha perfectly blends with the sweet and tangy flavors of fresh fruits. This multi-layered creation offers a rich taste experience, where the aromatic matcha and refreshing fruits create an unexpected delight for your palate.

items.name: 草莓千層2
items.description: 新鮮草莓與精緻千層蛋糕的完美結合，層層薄餅皮夾著香滑的卡士達醬和當季草莓，甜而不膩的口感帶來滿滿的幸福滋味，每一口都是精心的手工藝術。
items.description_en: A delightful combination of fresh strawberries layered with delicate crepe sheets and smooth custard cream. This perfectly balanced treat offers a sweet yet not overwhelming flavor, with each layer crafted by hand to create an artisanal masterpiece.

items.name: 草莓千層3
items.description: 選用當季新鮮草莓，層層疊疊的薄餅皮與香滑卡士達醬交織出清新甜美的滋味，每一口都能感受到草莓的鮮甜與蛋糕的柔軟，是春日限定的美好饗宴。
items.description_en: Made with fresh seasonal strawberries, delicate layers of crepe and smooth custard cream create a refreshing and sweet delight. Each bite offers the natural sweetness of strawberries and the soft texture of the cake, a perfect springtime treat.

items.name: 巧克力千層
items.description: 選用頂級可可製成的濃郁巧克力千層，層層疊疊的薄餅皮與香濃巧克力奶油交織，濃郁而不甜膩，每一口都充滿巧克力的香醇，是巧克力愛好者的完美選擇。
items.description_en: Made with premium cocoa, this rich chocolate mille crepe features delicate layers of crepe interwoven with luxurious chocolate cream. Rich yet not overly sweet, every bite is filled with the aromatic richness of chocolate, perfect for chocolate lovers.
